about: A self-hosted control center for Bambu Lab 3D printers, from one printer to a whole farm.

prs.title: Spool import reads CSV files saved by European Excel
prs.broken: Excel in Germany, France and similar places saves CSV with ";" between fields and "24,99" for prices. The spool import read nothing from those files.
prs.changed: The import now spots the ";" separator from the header and reads decimal commas as numbers.
prs.matters: People outside English-speaking places can import their spool lists straight from Excel.
